description: ChronicleNativeDashboard is the Schema for the ChronicleNativeDashboard API

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object. Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and may reject unrecognized values. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents. Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to. Cannot be updated. In CamelCase. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: ChronicleNativeDashboardSpec defines the desired state of ChronicleNativeDashboard

definition.description: Optional. Definition of the dashboard like metadata, visualization and datasource configuration etc.

filtersIDs.description: Dashboard filters applied to the chart.

advancedFilterConfig.description: Optional. Advanced filter configuration for the filter widget.

defaultValues.description: Optional. Default values to use if no value is selected/provided.

multipleAllowed.description: Optional. Whether to allow selection of multiple values.

prefix.description: Optional. String to prepend to the final replaced value (e.g., "/", "^(", "\"").

separator.description: Optional. Delimiter to join multiple selected values (e.g., "|", " OR field = ").

skipDefaultAffixes.description: Optional. Whether to skip the configured prefix and suffix when using default values. If true, default values are inserted raw (joined by the separator).

suffix.description: Optional. String to append to the final replaced value (e.g., "/", ")$", "\"").

token.description: Required. The token name to look for in the query (e.g., "hostname"). The system will automatically wrap this in '$' (e.g., "$hostname$").

valueSource.description: Required. Source of the values for the filter.

manualOptions.description: Optional. Manual options provided by the user.

options.description: Optional. The options provided by the user. The max number of options is limited to 10000.

queryOptions.description: Optional. Query options to fetch the values from the query engine. This is used for the filter's population query.

column.description: Required. The column name to use for the values.

input.description: Optional. Time range input specifically for the filter's population query.

relativeTime.description: time range for last x units.

timeWindow.description: time range to fetch the data for.

endTime.description:
Optional. Exclusive end of the interval.

 If specified, a Timestamp matching this interval will have to be before the
 end.

startTime.description:
Optional. Inclusive start of the interval.

 If specified, a Timestamp matching this interval will have to be the same
 or after the start.

query.description: Required. The query to execute to fetch the values.

chartIDs.description: Chart IDs the filter is applicable for.

dataSource.description: Datasource the filter is applicable for.

filterOperatorAndFieldValues.description: Operator and values. Can include multiple modifiers.

fieldValues.description: Values for the modifier. All operators should have a single value other than 'IN' and 'BETWEEN'. 'PAST' will have negative seconds like -86400 is past 1 day.

filterOperator.description: Operator for a single filter modifier.

isMandatory.description: Optional. Whether this filter is required to be populated by the dashboard consumer prior to the dashboard loading.

isStandardTimeRangeFilter.description: Optional. Whether the filter is a standard time range filter, meaning that it has to be used as the query time range, and not as a predicate in the query. A chart can have at most one standard time range filter applied.

isStandardTimeRangeFilterEnabled.description: Optional. Whether this standard time range filter is enabled.

displayName.description: Required. Dashboard display name/title visible to users.

etag.description: Optional. This checksum is computed by the server based on the value of other fields, and may be sent on update and delete requests to ensure the client has an up-to-date value before proceeding.

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: The ChronicleNativeDashboard name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

status.description: ChronicleNativeDashboardStatus defines the config connector machine state of ChronicleNativeDashboard

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the object's current state.

lastTransitionTime.description: Last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description: Human-readable message indicating details about last transition.

reason.description: Unique, one-word, CamelCase reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: Status is the status of the condition. Can be True, False, Unknown.

type.description: Type is the type of the condition.

externalRef.description: A unique specifier for the ChronicleNativeDashboard resource in GCP.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the generation of the resource that was most recently observed by the Config Connector controller. If this is equal to metadata.generation, then that means that the current reported status reflects the most recent desired state of the resource.

observedState.description: ObservedState is the state of the resource as most recently observed in GCP.

access.description: Output only. Access of the dashboard

createTime.description: Output only. Creation time of dashboard.

createUserID.description: Output only. User who created the dashboard.

dashboardUserData.description: Output only. User Preferences for a dashboard

lastViewedTime.description: time when this dashboard is last viewed

definition.description: Optional. Definition of the dashboard like metadata, visualization and datasource configuration etc.

type.description: Output only. Whether it's an out of the box or custom created dashboard.

updateTime.description: Output only. Time the dashboard was last edited.

updateUserID.description: Output only. User who last edited the dashboard.
